_note: Scintilla, the 1981 Elka Synthex in integer C (GPL-3.0, github.com/joakimeriksson/esp32 commit eed6180, directory scintilla-p4-lcd35; licences in public/p4-scintilla-NOTICE.txt), on the Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-3.5 model: Waveshare's BSP 2.0.2 and LVGL 9 unmodified, the ST7796 on GPSPI2 through the AXI-GDMA, FT5x06 touch on I2C1, the ES8311's audio from I2S1 through the AHB-GDMA. The panel is portrait and the synth draws landscape (MADCTL 0xe8), shown rotated 90 degrees. The board's C6 is not attached here: ESP-Hosted's SDIO probe fails and BLE MIDI stays off; the synth does not need it.
